rows.text: divides qword `rcx+0x60` minus qword `rcx+0x58` by 40 (signed, as a multiply-high and shift); returns 1 when the low 32 bits of that quotient are zero or qword `+0x10` is zero, otherwise returns dword `+0x38` of the object at qword `+0x18`

notes: 001C0400: the divisor 40 is derived from the magic multiplier 0x6666666666666667 with sar 4 (the sign-correction shr 0x3F follows); the 16-digit constant is left out of the sentence.
